definitions.explanation: Describes something undergoing change by itself (intransitive). The transitive counterpart is {変|か}える (to change something).

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}が{変|か}わりました。
{天気|てんき}が{急|きゅう}に{変|か}わった。
{住所|じゅうしょ}が{変|か}わりましたか。

notes: Intransitive verb meaning something changes on its own. The transitive pair is {変|か}える (to change something). Common pattern: ～が{変|か}わる. Can also be written as {代|か}わる meaning 'to take over' or 'to substitute for.'
